verdict.rationale: Pulumi documents a plan-equivalent `pulumi preview` command that shows proposed changes without applying them. Automation API is its own programmatic interface for running and updating stacks without the interactive CLI, which supports CI-style non-interactive execution, and it has first-party GitHub, GitLab and Azure DevOps integrations. Missing for 10: any evidence of saved plan artifacts that are later applied, documented non-interactive approval flags for apply/update, a CI-specific workflow guide, and independent hands-on corroboration.
